supplement.method_paraphrase: The note specifies mashr0.2.79. Effects are Pi minus 0.5; the stated SE formula is abs(beta/sqrt(Chi-square)). Fitting uses tests available across all cell types with finite nonmissing effects and SE. Strong rows have FDR below 10% in any cell type; two million remaining peak-SNP pairs form a random control subset. Queries select the lowest-q SNP per peak across cell types. Missing query effects and SE are explicitly zero and 1e-6. The resulting effects and LFSR support significance at 0.05.
unresolved: The beta symbol in the SE formula requires explicit input-field mapping; do not infer a transformation from unsigned P values.
PCA/ED settings, mixture optimizer choices, random seed and other unreported fit settings remain analyst-supplied; do not infer them from a version number.
The very small reported missing-query SE must not be silently changed to 1e6 or 1e10. Zero/invalid derived SE still needs explicit analysis admission.
supplement.body_only_draft_supersession: This supplement adds an explicit MASH query-input missingness rule beyond the previously reviewed downstream RASQUAL correlation rule. The earlier frozen draft is preserved as history.

roles.role: mashr0.2.79 learns a prior from genes expressed in every cell type and empirical correlation from 600,000 random variant-trait pairs. Minimum-P targets use coefficient/SE, with missing coefficient0/SE1e6. The composite method sets p=1-LFSR and assumes independent marginal proxies: ALL=prod(p[include])*prod(1-p[exclude]); ANY=(1-prod(1-p[include]))*prod(1-p[exclude]). The article explicitly uses score>0.5 and reports a stricter 0.8 cutoff.
